name: Houkago ~Nureta Seifuku~
source:
In this game you play as a perverted teacher that happens to find one his students trying to steal a test paper to cheat with. He ends up black mailing her and forces her to have sex with him. Eventually, he uses her to help him screw all of the hottest girls from the school.

[From [url=http://www.hongfire.com/forum/forum/hentai-lair/hentai-game-discussion/409405-the-bishop-game-thread]Carn forum post[/url]]
